name: Luck of the Beast
body:
You call upon animal instinct to avoid bad situations.

Prerequisite: Anumus, 6th level, and either the Bestial Fortitude racial trait or the Bestial Reflexes racial trait.

Benefit: If Bestial Fortitude is granted by your subrace, once per day, you may reroll a failed Fortitude save. If Bestial Reflexes is granted by your subrace, once per day, you may reroll a failed Reflex save. This effect is used as an immediate action after the first save is attempted, but before the results are revealed by the GM. The anumus must take the second result, even if it is worse. This does not stack with other abilities that let you reroll saving throws.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
